PCA-001.note: One result per selected action in catalogue order; unknown IDs are reported in ignoredSelection and never run.

PCA-003.note: The engine tracks the working media by the last successful transformation; ActionExecutor owns the media and must not touch it on failure.

PCA-005.note: Native pipeline receipts retain confirmed working media and completed save artifacts after output failure/cancellation. Shared tray/main-window recovery actions open an immutable snapshot as a new unsaved editor document without consuming or rereading the saved capture. Explicit Discard/Cancel confirmation clears only the expected current in-memory receipt; saved files, clipboard contents and existing editor snapshots are preserved. Busy state, missing opener, stale approval, callback exception/reentrancy and owner destruction have private native UI/controller tests; editor tests prove exact source ownership/profile/alpha, empty durable path, cancelled Save and explicit new-file persistence. Only the latest receipt is retained in memory. Complete history/restart recovery, retention policy, remaining actions and physical/human qualification remain Required.

PCA-006.note: Temporary file creation and cleanup are covered by platforms/linux/linux-qt/tests/PostCapturePipelineTest.cpp.

PCA-007.note: Native PNG saving encodes once into an owner-private temporary file and atomically publishes through Linux RENAME_NOREPLACE. Existing files, dangling symlinks and racing writers are never replaced; collisions retry fresh random names. CaptureActions records the absolute native path, actual media type/byte length and immutable filename-generation context. Independent native tests cover exact pixels, concurrent/racing publication, private permissions, cleanup and value-free failures. Production canonical result serialization now emits the actual save artifact under a namespaced extension. Complete artifact catalogue, durable recovery, configured counter/storage integration, all save variants and native review/target qualification remain Required.

PCA-008.note: Annotation runs before save and a successful result becomes working media. Offering the re-editable document to persistence arrives with the ImageEditor.

PCA-009.note: Selection cancel and replacement are implemented. Persisting a workflow change only on explicit user choice arrives with the selection UI.

PCA-010.note: The same Qt Core engine runs native actions on a worker with a reachable cancellation token. Escape and Cancel Capture request cancellation while saving; an uninterruptible save may finish, records cancellation_arrived_during, and later clipboard work is cancelled. A claimed native clipboard call retains its actual outcome even if cancellation arrives during it; unclaimed calls cannot publish late. Native tests cover before-start, save/clipboard races, GUI responsiveness, destruction and actual overlay Escape. Full action catalogue and supported native matrix qualification remain Required.

PCA-011.note: Retry needs the persisted pipeline result from PCA-012.

PCA-012.note: Durable pipeline results and recovery (interrupted state) arrive with history persistence.

PCA-013.note: The engine emits stable diagnostic codes. Native capture-save encoding, publication and hook exceptions return value-free codes; private file paths and filename context remain artifact data rather than ordinary diagnostics. Complete native action privacy/diagnostic and human review coverage remain Required. The result-report serializer accepts no raster bytes, clipboard payload, recognized text or credential data; private artifact path/context appear only in user-requested review details with a privacy notice. Private native fixtures verify exception redaction and unchanged clipboard/files.

PCA-014.note: One engine, runPipeline(), serves configured workflows, quick actions, and conformance. No UI surface exists yet.

PCA-015.note: Core seams and native worker jobs isolate selected-action snapshots, media, files, receipts and cancellation by unique task ID. Real parallel native pipelines prove one cancelled job cannot corrupt another successful job. Configured workflow counters, temporary upload files, remaining actions and full persistence/target qualification remain Required.

PCA-016.note: The application native receipt and thin adapter now call one Qt Core production canonical serializer. The four published result fields and applicable action/dependency/cancellation fields remain intact; actual task identity, UTC execution times and native saved-file path/type/integer byte-length/naming context are under extensions.com.xerahs.app version 1. Native shared tray/main-window review shows an immutable read-only report without retry, file, clipboard or receipt mutations. Published vectors and independent Core/native/privacy/UI fixtures cover this seam. Serialization does not provide durable journal/restart recovery, retry authority, remaining artifact catalogue or human/native matrix acceptance; those remain Required.

PCA-017.note: The compiled catalogue is checked against actions.json by platforms/linux/linux-qt/tests/PostCapturePipelineTest.cpp.
